items.text: Rams WR Puka Nacua left practice early Thursday due to a calf injury and was listed as limited. Already without Davante Adams (IR, 6-10 weeks hamstring).
items.why: Calf injury mid-practice; Adams already out long-term.
items.implication: Major target vacuum if Nacua sits or limited; monitor Friday report.
items.opportunity: Increased routes/targets for Rams TEs (Higbee) and remaining WRs; Stafford volume concentrates.

items.text: Chiefs WR Rashee Rice officially did not practice for a second straight day due to hamstring injury.
items.why: Hamstring from Week 4; missed Week 6 and now two DNPs post-bye.
items.implication: Likely OUT or high-risk for Week 7 vs SEA; Worthy/Kelce elevated.
items.opportunity: Xavier Worthy target share spike; Travis Kelce routes.

items.text: Breece Hall back to practice (Jets Thursday injury report).
items.why: Returned to practice after quad issue.
items.implication: Path to active for Week 7 vs MIA; monitor designation.
items.opportunity: Full backfield role if cleared; Braelon Allen reduced.

items.text: Seahawks activated RB Zach Charbonnet from the PUP list, a significant move.
items.why: Activated from PUP; ready for Week 7.
items.implication: Kenneth Walker handcuff now available; potential committee or change-of-pace.
items.opportunity: Charbonnet snaps/carries if Walker limited; Walker value slightly diluted.

items.text: Josh Jacobs was allowed in team meetings, lifting, medical treatments and non-football activities at facility. MarShawn Lloyd (49th EPA/rush of 54) and Kaleb Johnson (53rd) have been quite bad; OL mess too. Discussed Jacobs long-term on ROS Top-150.
items.why: Facility access signals return path; backups poor EPA.
items.implication: Jacobs ROS value holds if clears personal issues; fade Lloyd/Johnson.
items.opportunity: Jacobs carries/snaps resume; handcuff value low.

items.text: Lamar Jackson is present for the start of Thursday’s Ravens practice.
items.implication: Strong chance to play Week 7 vs CIN; boosts Flowers/Henry/Andrews.

items.text: LOVE Jaylen Warren @ NO (RB9), Chuba Hubbard vs TB (RB10), Bucky Irving @ CAR (RB12): Big workloads in friendly matchups; defenses carved up by RBs. Saquon Barkley in-line to play vs DAL (efficient when healthy; Dallas good RB matchup).
items.why: Workloads + matchups; Saquon limited practice but expected.
items.implication: Start these RBs confidently; Saquon RB2.
items.opportunity: Carries/red-zone for all; Saquon snaps resume.

items.text: Terrance Ferguson (eligible off IR next week) not expected ready soon; recovery will take time. Notable as he was biggest beneficiary of Davante Adams injury. Rams' only answer now is 25 Puka Nacua targets per game.
items.implication: Puka massive target share if healthy; calf now clouds it.
items.conflict: Conflicts with new calf injury limiting him.

items.text: Multiple teams open to potential trade for Colts RB Jonathan Taylor; unclear if Colts ready to unload before deadline.
items.implication: ROS uncertainty or boost if moved to better spot; monitor deadline.
items.opportunity: Potential role change; Colts handcuffs rise if dealt.

items.text: LOVE A.J. Brown @ CHI (WR10): Bears good place for yardage; Brown back in real role with elite usage/matchup.
LOVE DeVonta Smith vs DAL (WR11): Elite volume; Dallas matchup friendly.
HATE Josh Jacobs @ DET (RB18): Workload question after long layoff. Also HATE Cam Skattebo @ HOU (brutal spot), Rome Odunze vs NE, Josh Downs @ MIN, Travis Kelce @ SEA.
items.conflict: Conflicts slightly with Levitan facility positive on Jacobs.

items.text: Thorman Snaps & Pace Week 7: Up in pace TB @ CAR; slow slogs MIA @ NYJ. High volume notes GB/DET, LAR/LV. Packers-Lions fantasy-friendliest; Rams-Raiders party despite Adams/Puka concerns.
items.implication: Prioritize high-volume games for DFS/season-long stacks.
items.opportunity: Elevated snaps/routes in TB/CAR, GB/DET, LAR/LV; avoid MIA/NYJ slog.

items.text: Yards per target to Justin Jefferson: Mullens 10.8, Cousins 10.5, Darnold 10.0, Wentz 9.9, JJ McCarthy 5.7. Different scheme/coaches/small sample but tough to ignore; McCarthy starting for Giants vs HOU.
items.implication: Jefferson efficiency concern short-term with McCarthy under center.
items.opportunity: Monitor target quality/routes; potential volume still high.
